'''Kalia Karede''' was the wife of [[Furyk Karede]].

==History==
Kalia married Furyk Karede, and had three sons with him. Two of them joined the [[Deathwatch Guard]], but Kalia and her other son died in the [[Great Fire of Sohima]].<ref name=comp>[[The Wheel of Time Companion]], Kalia.</ref>

While her husband shudders at the thought of the [[One Power]] touching him, he wonders if it might have saved her.{{ref/book|11|36}}
